newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African troops to Zimbabwe to learn peacekeeping.
newsitem.headline: S.African troops to Zimbabwe to learn peacekeeping.

text.p: South Africa said on Friday it would send 1,250 troops to Zimbabwe for training in what national television news called a first step towards a regional peacekeeping force.
"We have never had an opportunity to participate in any peacekeeping operation," Defence Minister Joe Modise told a news conference.
"The Zimbabweans who are going to host these operations have extensive knowledge in peacekeeping."
State-funded television said the training was part of a plan to found a multinational peackeeping force under the auspices of the 12-nation Southern African Development Community, SADC.
South Africa said this week it had trained two battalions to be ready for multinational peacekeeping and would be willing to contribute up to 1,000 men to any such operation it approved.
